title: Grateful Dead Live at Euphoria Ballroom on 1970-07-16

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a stellar second set featuring a smoking Not Fade Away jam, gorgeous Attics performance and a seamless NFA→St. Stephen transition.
ai_review.review: The recording is a pristine sound‑board source with crystal‑clear guitar tone and a superb mix that lets every nuance shine. Musically the show stands out for its incendiary Not Fade Away jam, a breathtaking Attics rendition, and a beautifully crafted segue into St. Stephen, all backed by high‑energy band interplay. Reviewers consistently rave about both the performance and the audio fidelity.

ai_rating.rationale: All eight reviews are strongly positive, highlighting an exceptional musical performance and describing the recording as outstanding; weighted combination of show (70%) and recording (30%) yields a near‑excellent rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Captured from Jerry's original Ampex 456 tape via a high‑end Mackie console; reviewers call the mix great, guitar tone outrageous and the overall fidelity crystal clear with no noted flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows beautifully, highlighted by a powerful Not Fade Away jam that segues flawlessly into St. Stephen, with Attics and Cumberland adding high‑energy peaks throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his tone and interplay with Bob on the Not Fade Away jam.
band_member_comments.Bob: Described as being on top of his game, delivering an extraordinary guitar performance especially on Not Fade Away.
